author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Some years of peace that had ended in an instant with one of those terribly frightening screams resurfaced in his mind. Their details, however minute, came back to his memory with such intensity that even reality no longer seemed as "real".

jyutping: gei2 nin4 ge3 wo4 ping4，hai2 keoi5 nou5 hoi2 jap6 min6 cung4 san1 fau4 jin6 faan2 saai3 ceot1 lai4，go2 di1 zim1 giu3 seng1 hai2 jat1 seon3 gaan1 git3 cuk1 maai4。keoi5 dei6 ge3 sai3 zit3，mou4 leon6 gei2 gam3 sai3 zit3，dou1 ji5 gam3 koeng4 lit6 ge3 koeng4 dou6 faan1 lai4 keoi5 ge3 gei3 jik1，ling6 dou3 lin4 maai4 di1 jin6 sat6 dou1 m4 zoi3 hou2 ci5「zan1 sat6」gam3。
text: 幾年嘅和平，喺佢腦海入面重新浮現返晒出嚟，嗰啲尖叫聲喺一瞬間結束埋。佢哋嘅細節，無論幾咁細節，都以咁強烈嘅強度返嚟佢嘅記憶，令到連埋啲現實都唔再好似「真實」咁。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: LISA will place three spacecraft in orbit around the Sun, tagging along behind Earth. The three spacecraft will be 5 million kilometers apart flying in a triangle formation. When a gravitational wave passes by, these ripples in space gently push the spacecraft around by the tiniest amount imaginable. But the super-super-super sensitive laser beams that connect the three spacecraft will allow this tiny movement to be measured.

jyutping: LISA wui5 zoeng1 saam1 sau2 taai3 hung1 syun4 fong3 hai2 waan4 jiu2 taai3 joeng4 ge3 gwai2 dou6 soeng6，gan1 zyu6 dei6 kau4 hau6 min6 fei1。saam1 sau2 taai3 hung1 syun4 zi1 gaan1 soeng1 gaak3 500 maan6 gung1 lei5，zou2 sing4 jat1 go3 saam1 gok3 jing4 zan6 sik1 fei1 hang4。dong1 jan5 lik6 bo1 ging1 gwo3 go2 zan6，ni1 di1 taai3 hung1 ge3 lin4 ji2 wui5 gik6 hing1 mei4 gam3 teoi1 ji4 taai3 hung1 syun4，fuk1 dou6 sai3 dou3 naan4 ji5 soeng2 zoeng6。daan6 saam1 sau2 taai3 hung1 syun4 zi1 gaan1 lin4 zip3 ge3 ciu1 kap1－ciu1 kap1－ciu1 man5 gam2 gik1 gwong1 cuk1，zau6 nang4 caak1 loeng4 dou3 ni1 di1 gik6 mei4 siu2 ge3 ji4 dung6。
text: LISA 會將三艘太空船放喺環繞太陽嘅軌道上，跟住地球後面飛。三艘太空船之間相隔500萬公里，組成一個三角形陣式飛行。當引力波經過嗰陣，呢啲太空嘅漣漪會極輕微咁推移太空船，幅度細到難以想像。但三艘太空船之間連接嘅超級－超級－超敏感激光束，就能測量到呢啲極微小嘅移動。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Love: A temporary insanity curable by marriage or by the removal of the patient from the influences under which he incurred the disorder. This disease, like caries and many other ailments, is prevalent only among civilized races living under artificial conditions; barbarous nations breathing pure air and eating simple food enjoy immunity from its ravages. It is sometimes fatal, but more frequently to the physician than to the patient.

jyutping: oi3 cing4：jat1 zung2 zaam6 si4 sing3 zing1 san4 co3 lyun6，ho2 tau3 gwo3 git3 fan1 waak6 zoeng1 waan6 ze2 ji4 lei4 jan5 faat3 beng6 zing3 ge3 waan4 ging2 ji4 zi6 jyu6。ne1 zung2 beng6，hou2 ci5 zyu3 ngaa4 tung4 hou2 do1 kei4 taa1 beng6 zing3 jat1 joeng6，zi2 hai2 man4 ming4 zung2 zuk6、wut6 hai2 jan4 wai4 waan4 ging2 zi1 haa6 sin1 zi3 lau4 hang4；je5 maan4 man4 zuk6 fu1 kap1 seon4 zing6 hung1 hei3、sik6 gaan2 daan1 sik6 mat6，zau6 jyun4 cyun4 min5 jik6。jau5 si4 wui6 zi3 ming6，daan6 tung1 soeng4 zi3 ming6 ge3 deoi3 zoeng6 hai6 ji1 saang1 do1 gwo3 beng6 jan4。
text: 愛情：一種暫時性精神錯亂，可透過結婚或將患者移離引發病症嘅環境而治癒。呢種病，好似蛀牙同好多其他病症一樣，只喺文明種族、活喺人為環境之下先至流行；野蠻民族呼吸純淨空氣、食簡單食物，就完全免疫。有時會致命，但通常致命嘅對象係醫生多過病人。
